description: Creates a draft application at the named school and emails a 6-digit code to the parent or guardian. The application object must match that school's schema (get_school_instructions). Read the payload back to the family before calling this.

application.description: The application body, per the school's schema

school.description: The school's slug from list_schools, e.g. "vvs"

name: start_application
title: Start an application
